decision: Legacy per-bundle reads are found by a Vitest test that type-checks apps/web/src and matches property accesses, string element accesses and destructurings whose root symbol is an activeCompany field of current-actor.ts other than id, displayName, grants and *Capture; a per-file count allowlist must equal the measured reads
why: A lint rule cannot see types without typed linting; root symbols also catch Pick-derived types; an exact count lets one file migrate area by area and fails on a stale entry so the list only shrinks

decision: The web mirror gains COMPANY_GRANT_LABELS (bundle id to registry label), guarded against the API registry; CAPTURED_VERSIONS of the access administration parser is derived from the mirror and labels
why: One web source of captured versions; the derived table equals the deleted hand-written one (compared before deletion)

decision: A malformed or unknown captured grant of a migrated area now refuses the whole current Actor instead of denying only that feature; tests that fed malformed legacy fields assert the refusal through readCurrentActor, and cases the parser accepts (no grant, a non-native assignment id) keep the feature-only denial
why: The #1332 parser policy for grants; the API ships registry and mirror from one commit, so such a grant never reaches a real browser

decision: Fixtures build grants through companyGrants/withCompanyGrants/withoutCompanyGrants (access/company-grants.test-fixture.ts); a migrated bundle loses its legacy fixture fields, a bundle still read by an unmigrated file keeps them beside its grant; a read-only pricing configuration fixture becomes a Pricing User grant
why: Registry-consistent by construction; the only registry bundle with configuration read and no management is Pricing User
